# Mental Floss

> Mental Floss is a knowledge and entertainment platform offering trivia, quizzes, and fascinating facts across entertainment, literature, history, geography, music, and language.

Mental Floss provides engaging educational content through interactive quizzes, brain teasers, and curated articles spanning pop culture, literary history, music facts, travel destinations, and etymology. The site features signature quiz formats like Kennections and covers topics from Shakespeare to Studio Ghibli.

## Key Topics

- Quizzes & Trivia
- Pop Culture
- Entertainment
- Literary History
- Music Facts
- Travel & Wanderlust
- Etymology & Language
- History & Historical Figures
- Nursery Rhymes
- Word Games
- Movies & TV
- Vocabulary
- Brain Teasers
- BookTok
- Kennections

## Core Content Hubs

- [Quizzes, Trivia, General Knowledge Tests & More](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes): Quiz hub featuring trivia games, brain teasers, and Kennections.
- [Entertainment Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment): Entertainment hub featuring trivia and quizzes on TV, movies, and music.
- [History Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/history): History facts on historical figures, events, and cultural topics.
- [Movies Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/movies): Movie facts and quizzes covering Disney, Studio Ghibli, and film awards.
- [TV Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/tv): TV facts, quizzes, and trivia on shows, sitcoms, and celebrities.
- [Music Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/music): Music facts and trivia on famous musicians and musical history.
- [Literature Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature): Literature hub with facts on books, authors, and nursery rhymes.

## Language & Words

- [Language - Facts, Trivia, Quizzes, Brain Teasers & More](https://www.mentalfloss.com/language): Language facts on etymology, word games, vocabulary, and Wordle.
- [Words Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/words): Word facts, etymology, and language history with quizzes.

## Geography & Travel

- [Geography Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/geography): Geography hub with travel guides, city facts, and wanderlust content.
- [Wanderlust Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/geography/wanderlust): Travel destinations and literary-inspired places worldwide.

## Special Topics & Collections

- [Big Questions Answered, How and Why](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/big-questions): Q&A section answering life's mysteries from science to everyday facts.
- [Award Show History, Nominations, Winners](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/awards): Award show history and facts about Grammys, Oscars, and BAFTAs.
- [Holidays Facts, History & Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/holidays): Holiday facts and origins for St. Patrick's Day, Valentine's Day, and more.
- [All Stories - Trivia, Quizzes, and Brain Teasers](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/all): Archive of all Mental Floss content across categories.

## Community & Engagement

- [Mental Floss Newsletter Sign-Up](https://www.mentalfloss.com/mental-floss-newsletters): Newsletter signup page for Mental Floss editorial content.

## Featured Quizzes

- [Quiz: Who Said It—Gandalf or Dumbledore?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/who-said-it-gandalf-dumbledore): Interactive quiz comparing quotes from Gandalf and Dumbledore.
- [The Surprisingly Dark Origins of 'Three Blind Mice'](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/nursery-rhymes/dark-origins-three-blind-mice): Article on dark history of nursery rhyme linked to Mary I.
